photos.title: Лиза с дедушкой
photos.description: Вечер. Лиза с дедушкой рассматривают фотоальбом. В этом альбоме собраны фотографии о военной службе нашего дедушки. Он делится историями о прыжках с парашютом, и о том, как однажды смог установить связь за что получил награду. Лиза с радостью находит его на всех фотографиях. В такие моменты понимаешь настоящую ценность фотографий. Преемственность поколений, возможность вернуться в прошлое, вновь испытать забытые эмоции. Я верю, что эти фотографии в будущем Лиза будет показывать своим детям и рассказывать о своем дедушке.

They are not born to the same mother but they became close to each other with the life they lived

They meet everyday when the sun rises and explore the world possibly in a very phenomenal way until the sunsets 
They don't play temple run or subway surfers they run with their own feet on the roads and between fields of nature 
They play with the old tyre on the roads and bid a very small and hardest bye to each other hoping for a change in their lives atleast by the next day they wake

photos.title: Winter Morning
photos.description: Of the six seasons, the winter is undoubtedly the coldest season in Bangladesh. There remains dense fog all around in winter. Sometimes, the fog is so dense that the sun rays cannot get through it. Everything looks hazy. As a result, the communication system is disrupted. And it causes much hardship to the people. Sometimes, cold waves blow throughout the country. The sun having risen, the old and the children enjoy basking in the sun to get rid of cold. The dewdrops fell on the grass and the leaves sparkle like pearls in the rays of the morning sun. This scene makes the earth look glamorous. The date juice sellers become busy for selling date juice from door to door. People from all walks of life, specially the villagers enjoy eating native cakes which are called ‘Pithas’ in Bangla. The scene of a winter morning is very transitory. This Scene starts disappearing as the day advances.
